name: XLA_JE_RULE_SETS_B
description: This table contains the journal entry rule set information.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Context of the accounting methods builder for the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: JERS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal entry rule set. The possible values are: C: owned and defined by the user. S: owned and seeded by Oracle.

columns.name: JERS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event class of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event type of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: JE_RULE_SETS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of journal entry rule set.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COA_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts that is associated to the ledger that owns the transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_COA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the chart of accounts that is associated to the ledger that owns the journal entry.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates if the journal entry rule set is defined for commitment control or not.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type code of the description assigned to the journal entry rule Set at the journal header level. The possible values are: C: owned and defined by the user. S: owned and seeded by Oracle.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_CODE
columns.description: Code of the description assigned to the journal entry rule set at the journal header level.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACCT_RULE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: COMPILE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: LOCKING_STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used. Default value is Yes for required.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
